blocks.text: Nadine Samonte and her non-showbiz husband, Richard Chua, marked their 13th wedding anniversary by reaffirming their commitment to each other. The couple was surrounded by their family and friends as they renewed their wedding vows on Thursday, Oct. 29. Moments from the event were shared through the pair’s respective Instagram pages. “Happy 13th Anniversary, my love! After 13 beautiful years together, here we are, renewing our vows and promising to love each other all over again,” the actress wrote. “I love you so much, my love and I love our three beautiful kids more than words can ever express.
